import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep, colored by Gender
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', style='Sleep Disorder', palette='deep')

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Gender and Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
